def wrap_text(text, width):
    words = text.split()
    if not words:
        return []
    lines = []
    line_words = [words[0]]
    line_len = len(words[0])
    for w in words[1:]:
        if line_len + 1 + len(w) <= width:
            line_words.append(w)
            line_len += 1 + len(w)
        else:
            lines.append(' '.join(line_words))
            line_words = [w]
            line_len = len(w)
    lines.append(' '.join(line_words))
    return lines

def group_consecutive(lst):
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lst)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and lst[j] == lst[i]:
            j += 1
        result.append([lst[i], j - i])
        i = j
    return result
